newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures closed lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board on Thursday in moderate trade on some late local selling interest, brokers said.
"The market was flat all morning. It was very quiet and the market didn't change much in the afternoon," a local rubber broker said.
"It's just another dull day in the market, quiet and featureless. Prices in Tokyo and Kobe were narrowly mixed today but there was no follow-through buying or selling here," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, January/March RSS3 fell 1.25 cents to 131.00 U.S. cents a kg.
October RSS1 fell 1.50 cents to 181.50 Singapore cents (US$1.29) a kg.
November TSR20 eased 0.25 cent to 178.25 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
